senses.gloss: , (Parel of עֲקַל; v. P. Sm. 2964) to confuse, perplex. Part. pass. מְעַרְקַל, pl. מְעַרְקְלִין.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 29:20">Targ. Prov. XXIX, 20</cite> <he>דמע׳ מילוי</he> (Levita <he>דמערקלא</he>, incorr.) he whose words are confused (blurted; h. text <he>אץ בדבריו</he>).
